svg.title: The places the Navigators conversations are about, on an equal-area map
svg.desc: Colombia's Cauca Valley, Kijabe in Kenya, Bir and Panchgani in India and Manilla in Australia, on an Equal Earth map, which keeps every country's area true, with a curved graticule every 30 degrees.
svg.text: Equal Earth projection · graticule every 30° · places named in the conversations
